shadows.name: glow-red
shadows.purpose: High-impact spotlight glow for active racing elements.

motion.name: ease-motorsport
motion.purpose: Physics-based exponential deceleration for cards and drawers.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Quick response for buttons and toggles.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-velocity racing red primary action button with active scale feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E63946 0%, #C1121F 100%); color: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px 24px; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.4); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.35); transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Telemetry Chip
components.description: Racing telemetry badge for SKU specifications and product status flags.
components.css: .ds-telemetry-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; background: rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.15); color: #FF6B6B; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.3); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Glass Chassis Card
components.description: Frosted glass card with 1px alloy border and elevation for automotive components.
components.html:
BREMBO RACING CALIPER

Monobloc 4-Piston Performance Brake System
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(17, 22, 34, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid #1E2738; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-glass-card:hover { border-color: rgba(230, 57, 70, 0.4); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #FFFFFF; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: 'Prompt', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #9CA3AF; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: MOTIX merges the visceral mechanical urgency of an endurance racing pit stop with the clinical precision of a modern automotive design studio. The interface communicates speed, engineering rigor, and structural authority from the very first frame. Carbon dark finishes, crimson racing highlights, and tachometer-inspired amber accents evoke the cockpit telemetry of high-performance vehicles.
keyCharacteristics: Mechanical Precision with technical angular display typography
Cockpit Atmosphere with deep slate-carbon canvas and luminous red highlights
Glass Telemetry with frosted backdrop blurs simulating instrumentation HUD panels
Zero Cosmetic Slop with solid high-contrast text and clean physics easing

rules.name: The Rarity of Red Rule
rules.body: Primary Racing Red covers no more than 8% of any rendered viewport. Its purpose is conversion focus and urgent telemetry; when applied everywhere, it commands nothing.

rules.name: The No-Gradient-Text Rule
rules.body: Headings, hero display lines, and metrics use solid #FFFFFF, #F3F4F6, or #FF6B6B. Never use bg-clip-text text-transparent gradients.

rules.name: The Telemetry Uppercase Rule
rules.body: All system status indicators, badges, and SKUs are styled in uppercase Chakra Petch with 0.05em letter-spacing.

rules.name: The Boundary Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surface elevation must first be established by background tone contrast and a 1px boundary border; shadows are reserved strictly for interactive hover states and active dialogs.

dos: Do maintain bilingual translation coverage for English and Thai via src/locales/ on all user-facing views.
Do enforce minimum 44x44px touch bounding boxes on all mobile interactive controls.
Do use Chakra Petch for technical labels, badges, headers, and numeric prices.
Do use physics-based exponential easing (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for UI transitions.
Do provide motion-reduce:animate-none fallbacks for all continuous pulse/spin animations.
donts: Don't use decorative gradient text (bg-clip-text text-transparent) on headings or prices.
Don't apply decorative multi-axis grid overlays (racing-grid) on content surfaces.
Don't hardcode raw Thai or English strings without wiring them through useTranslation().
Don't render clickable actions as plain <span> or <div> without semantic <button> tags and keyboard focus handlers.
